sections.title: Hair and more
sections.content: You know *haj* ("hair"), *szőke*, *barna* and *fekete* from A1. The new word is *vörös* ("red, ginger").

*X haja van* ("has X hair") reuses the have-construction from A1 plus the 3rd-person possessive *-a/-e* you know from A1 — *haj* becomes *haja* because it's HIS or HER hair being described. *A kollégámnak fekete haja van* puts the owner first with *-nak/-nek* (you met that pattern in Unit 3), then the possessed noun, then *van*.
